title: Anchor log key matching at word boundaries
answers: Why does the logs panel freeze on a long log line without assignments?
How can log key highlighting avoid catastrophic regex backtracking?
Where is key=value highlighting defined for the logs panel?
body:
Symptom: The logs panel can stall when highlighting a long word without an '='.
Root cause: public/app/features/logs/components/panel/grammar.ts:logsGrammar — the log-token-key prefix (\b|\B) permits matching at every position, repeatedly scanning suffixes for an assignment and causing quadratic backtracking.
Fix pattern: Restrict candidate key starts to word boundaries with /\b[\w_]+(?=\s*=)/gi while retaining the assignment lookahead.
Constraints: Applies to word-style assignment keys in logs highlighting; preserve recognition of keys such as foo, status, and key_1 before '='. This pattern does not address other token rules.
applies: Logs panel Prism grammar changes affecting assignment-key recognition or performance on long unassigned words.
